channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-10-02 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 291¢/lb — up 4.4% on the week and down 11.5% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 14 sessions. Rainfall in the Central Highlands is running above its seasonal norm (+1.9σ) — favorable moisture for the robusta belt. The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is elevated. A weakening Brazilian real (+2.5% in a month) raises producers' local-currency revenue per bag — added selling pressure.
